info.name: Alice API Documentation api keys API

items.docs:
Endpoint: https://api.alice.io/v3/apikeys

The List API Keys retrieves a list of all existing API keys.

<u>Note</u>: The information presented per API Key includes metadata only, whereas the key itself is not exposed due to confidentiality considerations.

Endpoint: https://api.alice.io/v3/apikeys

The Generate New API Key allows generating a new API key with a specified name and optional description.

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier of the API key to be deleted.

items.docs:
Endpoint: https://api.alice.io/v3/apikeys/{id}

The Delete API Key deletes an API key by its identifier.
